## Experiment identity and binding

The additive v1 Quant protocol binds an exact Research preregistration reference,
verifier-selected pre-access checkpoint digest, ordered exact Data manifests for
train/validation/test/holdout, required split roles, content hashes for code,
configuration, environment and deterministic settings, seed policy and execution
assumptions. Actual trials repeat these fields and must equal the frozen protocol.
All manifests must predate the protocol freeze. Canonical memberships are pairwise
disjoint. The single holdout manifest must carry the exact preregistered membership
reference; renamed or reordered equivalent packaging cannot substitute for it and
canonical overlap is still detected.

The experiment identity hashes the protocol/preregistration, trial, actual splits,
code, configuration, environment, seed/determinism, first-access evidence, outputs,
metrics and complete trial-inventory reference. Rehashing a changed artifact creates
a different identity; silently replacing bytes breaks its reference.

## Research integration, inventories and contamination

The only positive confirmation gate invokes Research's checkpoint-aware
`check_confirmation_contract` with verifier inputs. Legacy experiment validation
and lower-level structural checks cannot return this Quant result. The current
Research registry is also checked against the independently supplied latest
accepted checkpoint. Research therefore retains preregistration, threshold,
analysis-plan, custody, exposure ancestry and canonical-overlap responsibilities;
Quant adds actual execution binding.

The selected current trial inventory must enumerate every accepted typed trial,
not a submitter-selected experiment subset. ATTEMPTED, SUCCEEDED, FAILED and
CANCELLED statuses are typed and counted; reasons and partial evidence remain.
Older inventories are historical snapshots only. Missing failed/cancelled/pending
trials, status rewrites, duplicate attempt ordinals, unaccepted additions and
misplaced Quant records deny. Any earlier trial with result access whose actual
test/holdout samples intersect the proposed holdout denies, including same,
renamed, reordered or partial membership reuse. Research independently inventories
typed exposures. Unrecorded external trials/access cannot be detected and are not
claimed complete.

## Checkpoint currency and race guarantee

`CurrentStateAuthority` supplies a pre-access checkpoint and a newest accepted
checkpoint with generation/predecessor metadata and a canonical state digest. Both
full-SHA inventories are verified; current must descend from pre-access and exactly
match live Research and Quant registries. The caller must name the authority's
current digest. Missing authority, stale digest, rollback, deleted/replaced accepted
bytes, absent later evidence, unaccepted additions or registry mismatch fail closed.

The critical Skeptic attack is reproduced: after a later overlapping exposure is
accepted and then deleted, Research supplied only the older pre-access checkpoint
can still return its bounded consistency result, but Quant denies because the newer
authority checkpoint cannot be reconstructed. Thus history preservation is not
misrepresented as currency.

The gate rechecks accepted bytes after evaluation, checks the authority again, then
uses `commit_if_current(expected_digest, assessment)`. The exact guarantee is:
if the externally trusted adapter performs that operation atomically, acceptance
between assessment and claim commit prevents the claim from committing. A plain
filesystem recheck alone is not claimed race-free. Adapter atomicity, controller
identity, anti-collusion and availability are external; no production authority is
currently provisioned, so operational use must deny.

## Output binding and reproduction

Successful trials require exact result-access evidence, named content-bound outputs
and metrics. Reproduction records bind the experiment identity and separate
reproduced blobs. Validation also requires a verifier-authored callable and compares
its output/metric bytes to both bound copies. Artifact-provided command strings are
never executed. The positive synthetic experiment deterministically reproduces
identity output and includes one failed, one cancelled and one nonterminal attempt.
It returns `SCIENTIFIC_INTEGRITY_CONSISTENT` with scientific-integrity eligibility
true and operational, paper, live and Risk authorization all false.

## Risk interface and deferred responsibility

`commit_confirmation_claim` returns a machine-readable assessment and durable
authority commitment token. The assessment carries its own digest, exact evidence
references, experiment identity, current-state digest, Research status, completeness
scope, limitations and explicit false authorization fields. Risk may verify/consume
this evidence but still owns trusted reviewer policy, lifecycle transition replay,
STOP enforcement/resolution, paper/live eligibility, bankroll, exposure/correlation,
kill switches and capital. Quant does not release Risk.

## Validation and preserved adversarial corpus

Quant 13/13, Data 18/18, Research-history v2 27/27, Skeptic-history v4 15/15
and foundation 18/18 pass. Repository validation reports 56 valid records and
preserved initial history; compileall and whitespace checks pass.
After adding completion artifacts, repository validation reports 59 valid records,
foundation remains 18/18 and all 29 frozen inventory hashes match.

Full discovery is deliberately **NOT GREEN**: 148 methods, 108 passing, 40 errored
methods / 43 entries, zero assertion failures and zero skips. Normalized error
identities exactly equal the Director's classified pre-Quant corpus: 20 legacy
Research-v1 and 10 legacy Skeptic-v3 fixtures fail at mandatory checkpoint setup,
plus 13 inherited adversarial entries. There are no new or missing identities.
Forty prior test/fixture files and all STOP/review records are byte-unchanged; only
`tests/test_quant_protocol.py` is additive. These historical errors are preserved
evidence, not credited as newly reached attacks or hidden to claim a green build.

## Limitations and next gate

Local checks cannot prove unrecorded external access, honest upstream entity
identity, source truth, external custody, uncompromised verifier control, or a
dishonest adapter's atomicity. External dependency determinism is bounded by the
recorded environment and independent runner. No empirical profitability, sample
size or capital threshold was invented.

H-M0-014 requests independent Skeptic review of all mechanisms, tests, migrations,
the stale-checkpoint/deletion proof and the exact race claim. Director must verify
the completion commit (first commit adding H-M0-005 v5), hashes, remote ancestry and
Skeptic disposition before separately considering any Risk release. Completion or
green focused tests alone do not release Risk or clear the STOP.
